tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Cacao: the brand's cream; it has no second surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised slabs: product cards, panels, toasts' light theme siblings, popovers. Equals canvas in Cacao, where cards are drawn with line instead of a fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: meter and progress tracks, stepper body, skeleton base, hover highlight in pickers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-sunk and every *-soft fill (at least 4.5:1 in all themes). Also the selected-pill fill in pickers.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: vendor names, captions, helper lines, compare-at prices, on canvas, surface and surface-sunk (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines. Too faint for a control edge on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, OTP boxes, stepper and picker outlines (at least 3:1 on canvas and surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: the primary Add to bag button and nothing else per view. Lane is marigold; Cacao is terracotta.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (at least 4.5:1). Dark ink on marigold, cream on terracotta.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: badges (New, -20%), selected chip backgrounds, the free-delivery unlocked strip.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text or a thin mark: discount %, links, meter fill, on canvas, surface and accent-soft (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted fills: toasts, tooltips, the selected size pill, the chart hover card.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse fills (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse fills, such as a toast's second line (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success states with a word or tick beside them: Added, Delivered, code verified, free delivery unlocked. Text on canvas, surface and success-soft. Leans blue so it never relies on a red/green split.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text and the verified OTP boxes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirms, always with a word: wrong code, Remove item?. Text on canvas, surface and danger-soft. Cacao reuses terracotta, as its brand book says.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text and the errored OTP boxes.

tokens.name: love
tokens.usage: The filled wishlist heart and its burst (a mark, at least 3:1 on canvas and surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (at least 3:1 on canvas and surface).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (darkest step). Seller charts only; series are told apart by lightness and labelled in the legend and tooltip.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series (middle step).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series (lightest step that still holds 3:1 on surface).

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: One big statement per screen: ETA on the tracker, the order-confirmed line.

styles.name: type-kpi
styles.usage: Dashboard totals and the stacked-bars headline number. Tabular figures.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles; product name on the product page.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Buttons, pills, toast titles, form labels.

styles.name: type-price
styles.usage: Prices. Always tabular figures, en-IN grouping.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: Vendor lines, legends, step labels, helper text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, digit gaps in the OTP row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside pills and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile; toast padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between product cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding inside panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: OTP boxes, inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Product image corners, panels, meters.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, the tracker card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Anything you press: buttons, size pills, steppers, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Cacao has no soft card shadow; cards there are hairline-framed.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating chrome: toasts, chart hover card, lifted cards on hover.

duration.note: Motion timing. Read as CSS custom properties; drop to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion (bundle.css does this).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills, colour changes, press-down.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Pill glides, image swaps, toast fan-out.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Number rolls, meter fills, progress steps.

easing.note: Curves. The spring overshoots slightly and is kept for confirmations only.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering or settling.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Confirmations: heart pop, tick draw, selected pill landing, digit roll.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Shimmer sweeps and looping pulses.
